recent: L&P Global 近期宣布拟多元化进入快速消费品零售与建筑业务，并接获总额 RM11.76 million 的有条件工程合约。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收同比下滑 22.0%，但净利转为 RM3.901 million。
notable: 接获总额 RM11.76 million 的有条件建筑与零售相关工程合约。
risks: 公司拟进行业务多元化，进入与现有包装业务不同的领域。
最新季度营收同比下滑 22.0%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 RM14.896 million，同比下滑 22.0%，环比微降 1.4%；净利为 RM3.901 million，净利率 26.2%，较上一季度的 -8.1% 转正。

recent_en: L&P Global recently proposed diversifying into FMCG retail and construction, and accepted conditional contracts worth RM11.76 million. It also proposed disposing of a leasehold land and buildings in Kulim, Kedah. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell 22.0% year-on-year but net profit turned to RM3.901 million.
notable_en: Accepted conditional contracts worth RM11.76 million for building and retail-related works.
Proposed diversifying into FMCG retail trading and construction.
Proposed disposal of a leasehold land and buildings in Kulim, Kedah.
risks_en: The company plans to diversify into areas different from its existing packaging business.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM14.896 million, down 22.0% year-on-year and 1.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM3.901 million with a net margin of 26.2%, turning positive from -8.1% in the previous quarter.
